project: ArcadeRecomp — original The House of the Dead (hotdo), Sega Model 2C
disclaimer: SUBJECTIVE, rounded engineering estimates, NOT an objective coverage calculation or a statement of hardware fidelity. Component percentages and overall estimate are separately reviewed; never take a simple average. Code/tests completing a scoped task do not complete its parent platform.

overall.title: Faithful native HOTD1 PC port (original hotdo)
overall.scope: Original 1997 HOTD1 arcade behavior, faithfully playable end to end, with separately native-translated program and all Model 2C devices. Estimate NOT computed from child areas.
overall.next: First capture and implement 315-5649 authentic status/RX to advance uninterrupted original boot; then MB86235/video, sound and verified gameplay.

gates.name: Original HOTD1 main CPU AOT operational

areas.title: ROM authenticity & reconstruction

areas.next: Extend exercised original code coverage, Intel fault/interrupt delivery, FP rounding and exact memory effects; verify against independent original-board traces.

areas.next: Capture exact 837-12079 gun board pin/protocol responses and prove circuit acceptance/behavior independently; streaming configuration parsing is not a recovered circuit.

areas.title: MB86235 geometry & Model 2C video
areas.next: Start separate MB86235/TGPx4 AOT translator; implement geometry FIFO and original texture/video/raster pipelines, validated against cabinet reference captures.

areas.title: Original HOTD1 end-to-end gameplay
areas.next: Gate on authentic cold boot reaching game logic; then validate both guns, all four chapters, branches, bosses, service modes and endings.
